content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I need support resolving an issue where I have two analog inputs, and I want the analog output to always reflect the maximum value between them at any given moment. I searched the forum but did not find a solution. Thank you for your help. Best regards, [user_name]
The analog output operates from 0 to 1000, where 1000 represents either 10 Volt or 20 mA. If the value sent to the analog output exceeds 1000, the output remains capped at 1000.

Thank you for your reply. I realize I did not describe the situation clearly enough. Let me illustrate with examples: For instance, when Analog Input 1 is 156 and Analog Input 2 is 200, then the Analog Output should be 200. If Analog Input 1 is 156 and Analog Input 2 is 100, then the Analog Output should be 156. When both inputs are 0, the output is 0. Essentially, I want to ensure the analog output always matches the higher value from the two analog inputs.
Hello, I am ready to provide a solution for your request.
Brilliant solution! Thank you very much. Wishing you a great day!

analysis.insight_summary: A user requested help in configuring their setup so that the analog output always matches the larger of two analog input values. Other users contributed further explanation regarding analog output scaling and provided a solution. The discussion was constructive, ended on a positive note, and did not mention any issues with the hardware or software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a straightforward way to configure the analog output so it continuously represents the maximum value of two analog inputs in real time.
